description_localkey:
A pilot from the Heavy Gram squad who operates T.A.L.O.S., a robot equipped with high-performance AI.
They have a record of being in multiple squads but struggle to find a place to belong.

element_details.element_desc_localekey: Injects Code: H.S.T.A. to all wind-type enemies, dealing 10% additional damage.

piece_detail.description_localkey:
Used for a Nikke's Limit Break.
Spare Bodies for a fully enhanced Nikke will be converted into Body Labels.

shot_detail.description_localkey:
■ Affects target(s).
<color=#00AEFF>Deals {damage}% of ATK as damage.
Deals {core_damage_rate}% damage when attacking core.</color>

skill2_detail.description_localkey:
■ Activates after performing {description_value_01} normal attacks while in the Nano Coating state. Affects self.
<color=#00AEFF><word_group=10048>Restores Shield HP</word_group> equal to {description_value_02}% the skill user's <word_group=10025>final</word_group> max HP.</color>
■ Activates when using Burst Skill while not in the Nano Coating state. Affects self.
<color=#00AEFF>Effects vary according to the number of uses. Each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it:</color>
<color=#00AEFF>Once: <word_group=10047>Next Shield's HP</word_group> ▲ {description_value_03}% continuously.</color>
<color=#00AEFF>Twice: <word_group=10047>Next Shield's HP</word_group> ▲ {description_value_04}% continuously.</color>
<color=#00AEFF>Three times: <word_group=10047>Next Shield's HP</word_group> ▲ {description_value_05}% continuously.</color>

skill1_detail.description_localkey:
■ Activates at the start of battle. Affects self.
<color=#00AEFF>Nano Coating: Creates a <word_group=10023>shield</word_group> with HP equal to {description_value_01}% of the skill user's <word_group=10025>final</word_group> max HP. This effect is continuous.</color>
■ Activates when using Burst Skill while not in the Nano Coating state. Affects self.
<color=#00AEFF>Nano Coating: Creates a <word_group=10023>shield</word_group> with HP equal to {description_value_02}% of the skill user's <word_group=10025>final</word_group> max HP. This effect is continuous.</color>

ulti_skill_detail.description_localkey:
■ Activates if the skill user is in the Nano Coating state. Affects all enemies.
<color=#00AEFF>Converts {description_value_01}% of <word_group=10025>final</word_group> max HP to ATK before dealing {description_value_02}% of ATK as damage.</color>
■ Activates if the skill user is not in the Nano Coating state. Affects self.
<color=#00AEFF>Max HP ▲ {description_value_03}% for {description_value_04} sec.</color>

squad_detail.squad_description:
One of the T.A.V:H squads that use piloted mechs developed by Missilis Industry for Nikkes.
The piloted humanoid robot and the Nikke piloting it are considered as one squad member.
Although the mech has garnered some reputation for its performance and versatility, one drawback is its excessively high production cost.

character_dialog_group_list.speech_localkey: Tell me if you need anything, and I'll see to it right away!
Hmm... What kind of function should I add for T.A.L.O.S. this time?

Huh? You want to take T.A.L.O.S. for a spin?
Only I can pilot T.A.L.O.S...

I've been with T.A.L.O.S. for a long time.
He's not just a colleague, but a friend.

No, I'm not uncomfortable inside here at all.
In fact, there's nowhere I'm more comfortable than here.
T.A.L.O.S. was born to engage in combat, and he can make anything I need in a snap. There's nothing he can't do. Isn't he amazing?
I hope I'm not boring you...

Um... when are you coming back?
I guess T.A.L.O.S. and I can play some word games until you get back.
Is there a workshop or armory here? Somewhere where T.A.L.O.S. can get a tune-up.
Just passing through.
Oh, sorry for blocking the way...

I'm Kilo from the Heavy Gram Squad.
T.A.L.O.S. Joined.

T.A.L.O.S., the maintenance is done. How is it?
Status optimal.

You have become stronger, Kilo. I'm proud of you.
It's not enough. I need to be stronger.
I'll do everything I can to be of help.
Oh wow, oh boy... okay, I gotta calm down...
Th-thank you. I will treasure it forever.

You're not going to store that in the cockpit, are you? 
The cockpit is already full of presents from the Commander, and there is not much space left...
You don't have to say everything out loud, T.A.L.O.S.!
I won't forget a single second that I spend with you, Commander.
Whenever I'm with you, I feel more energized.
Thank you for always believing in me.

T.A.L.O.S., wake up.
Reboot complete. Hello, Kilo.
A-are you talking to me?
Order received. Checking route.

Chance of success?
Very high.
Good. Let's go.
Let... Let's do this, everyone.
Engaging in combat.
T.A.L.O.S., initiate self-repair.
Calm down... keep calm...
Reload.
Kilo. Preparation complete.

- Let's go, T.A.L.O.S.!
- Roger.
Focus your fire! Fire everything we've got!
W-we did it!
Nothing to it.
Target down.
Eek...!
T.A.L.O.S., are you okay?!
External glove damaged.

Test failure.
I'm sorry... my best wasn't good enough...

Combat ended. We have won.
T.A.L.O.S., you did well!
